# API changes in Proxmox VE 8.2

<!-- Generated by @virtbase/proxmox-api-generator. Do not edit. -->

Differences between consecutive versions of the published API schema.
Anything marked **breaking** removes or narrows something callers could
rely on; everything else is additive.

## 8.2.5

Published 2024-11-19 · compared with 8.1.5 · 592 operations · breaking.

### Renamed or removed types

No longer exported from the `Proxmox` namespace — **breaking** for code
that imports them by name:

- `NodesHardwarePciPciindex`
- `NodesHardwarePciPciscan`
- `NodesHardwarePciPciscanParams`

### Removed

- `GET /nodes/{node}/hardware/pci/{pciid}`
- `GET /nodes/{node}/hardware/pci/{pciid}/mdev`
